review_scope: Only the existing native-Linux Solana fresh streaming encoder/read-decoder call paths and their exact resolved features. No general zstd-safe soundness claim.

reasons.RUSTSEC-2026-0395: StableInBuffer requires experimental and explicit enabling; current zstd graph does neither
reasons.RUSTSEC-2026-0396: Seekable APIs require seekable feature, absent from the complete current graph
reasons.RUSTSEC-2026-0397: current zstd wrappers never call OutBuffer::around_pos; private buffers use around at position zero
reasons.RUSTSEC-2026-0399: deprecated init_using_cdict/ddict requires experimental, absent from current graph
reasons.RUSTSEC-2026-0400: fresh Solana streaming contexts never mix unfinished streams with one-shot APIs
reasons.RUSTSEC-2026-0401: dictionary training is compiled but never called by the sole Solana consumers; no sample sizes admitted
reasons.RUSTSEC-2026-0402: CCtx try_clone requires experimental; current graph also never requests multithreaded workers
reasons.RUSTSEC-2026-0404: DCtx try_clone requires experimental and has no current caller
reasons.RUSTSEC-2026-0405: affected seekable compress_stream is not compiled; ordinary wrappers start InBuffer at zero
reasons.RUSTSEC-2026-0406: current contexts are single-threaded and configured before the first frame; no unfinished worker jobs
